profile_text.body:
Dynatrace, Inc. is a public company traded under the ticker DT and headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, with SEC CIK 0001773383. According to its website, it sells an observability platform that combines observability, AI, automation, and application security in one product, aimed at helping customers innovate faster, operate more efficiently, and improve business outcomes. The company describes itself as an AI-powered observability leader whose platform turns data into decisions and autonomous actions.

On AI specifically, the site says the future of observability is preventive and autonomous, using what it calls deterministic AI and AI agents to coordinate actions across cloud platforms, developer tools, and IT service management. That statement is attributed on the site to Stephen Elliot, Group Vice President at IDC. The site also quotes a customer saying that Dynatrace's AI engine provides early detection of potential system issues without false alarms, reducing the time needed to identify root causes from hours to minutes.

The company's legal exposure record shows 191 entries in Massachusetts. No individual lawsuits, products, or MCP servers are named in the material available.
